title: Report only the most frequent words of a word-frequency tool
request: Add `type WordCount struct { Word string; Count int }` and `Top(counts map[string]int, n int) []WordCount` to package wordfreq. Top returns the n most frequent words in descending order of count, with ties broken alphabetically by word. It returns all words when n exceeds their number, and no words when n is 0 or negative. Also add a `-top N` flag to the command in cmd/wordfreq: with the flag, the command prints only the top N words, in the order Top returns them, as `word count` lines; without the flag, its output stays as it is. Add unit tests for the new behaviour.
